title: pergularia daemia subsp. barbata
intro: Pergularia daemia subsp. barbata, commonly known as 'Devil's Claw', is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, and aiding in the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and constipation. The therapeutic actions of Pergularia daemia subsp. barbata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include harpagoside, harpagide, and 8-methoxycanthine, among others, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
